about_the_game:
Be the first to the frontline with Battlefield Pro. Get 25 Tier Skips on top of the base Battle Pass, the ability to host a 100 player persistent server in Portal, a dedicated bonus path, and more.

Battlefield Pro includes:
  • “Ignition” Pax Armata Engineer Soldier Skin
  • “Tactician” NVO-228E Weapon Package
  • “True Dominion” Cheetah 1A2 Vehicle Skin
  • “Cross Point” KBR Mark II Combat Knife Melee Skin
  • “Air Defense” Player Card Background
  • XP Booster
  • +5% extra XP for BF Pro owners (on top of the +10% from BP)
